summary: Tested the hierarchical client display in the grid, the wizard and the PDF cover. Grid: the 'Varios Rif' badge and tooltip on COT-2026-11-110-PYME work (ADIDAS/ARDENE, 6 RIFs, Sede Principal). Labels 'Razón Social (Sucursal)' and '(N sucursales)' show with their tooltips (15+ checked), and 454 normal cells keep their link. Wizard VPOS: scope-store-label rows read 'RIF — Razón Social — Sucursal/Sede Principal'. Wizard Payment Gateway: quote-sucursal-block works, but the select-client SEARCH results do not show the branch suffix (bug). PDF: Sucursal Beneficiaria, Alcance block, 'Varios RIF (N)' and regenerate-pdf of COT-2026-11-110-PYME all pass with the card on page 1. In a heavy case (VPOS, 6 shown RIFs with 4+ long store names each) the quote-number card spills onto page 2.

critical.issue: The projection (routes/clients.py ~line 718, and the hide branch ~703) returns only client_id/legal_name/rif/fantasy_name/... with no is_branch, sucursal or parent_client_id. So when the user types >=2 chars in select-client (QuoteWizardDialog line 484 uses clientSearchResults), all 8 options for J505366220 show the same text 'J505366220 — INVERSIONES COLD 2024, CA.' with no '— Paramo Caricuao' etc. The user cannot tell principal and branches apart. Fix: add is_branch, sucursal, parent_client_id (and marca_name) to both projections.

minor.issue: Overflow in a heavy case: VPOS (all cover_parties shown: cajas, integrador, aplicativo, pinpad, banco) with 6 shown RIFs and >=4 stores per RIF using long store names (~40 chars). The stores wrap to 2+ lines, and the NÚMERO DE COTIZACIÓN/fecha card plus the confidential seal move to page 2. The same overflow happens with 6 RIFs that have very long unbroken legal names. Realistic cases with 1-3 stores per RIF fit. Suggestion: cap the cell to one line (truncate the stores text / max 2 stores + '+N más'), or reduce max_rifs dynamically by estimated height.

RIFs are not grouped/sorted by marca before rendering. If multirif_distribution arrives interleaved (M0,M1,M0...), the 'Marca: X' header repeats. Sort by marca_name first. Grid tooltip groups correctly via byBrand.

ui_bugs.issue: Branch suffix missing for search results (root cause is the backend /clients/search projection, see backend critical). The initial list (clients.slice(0,50)) is fine.

issues: Sucursal names with trailing spaces in the data ('Paramo Caricuao ') render as 'INVERSIONES COLD 2024, CA. (Paramo Caricuao )'. Trim s.name/sucursal in quoteEntityTree/quoteClientLabel and in the backend cliente_sucursal (already .strip() there).

action_items: Add is_branch, sucursal, parent_client_id to the projections of GET /api/clients/search (routes/clients.py) so select-client search results show '— Sucursal'
Make the PDF cover scope block height-bounded (one-line stores cell or dynamic max_rifs) so the quote-number card always stays on page 1. Test: test_stress_many_rifs_long_names_fit_page1
Sort _cover_scope_rifs by marca to avoid duplicate brand headers
Trim sucursal names in the frontend labels
critical_code_review_comments: QuoteWizardDialog quote-sucursal-block finds the selected client with clients.find(...). It works because the full clients list is loaded, but it would break if clients were paginated.
The Varios Rif badge / scope label cells have no link to the client file (acceptable, but different from single cells).

success_rate.backend: 83% (5/6; the 1 failure is a heavy-case stress test)
